summary: [spec-fidelity] Two docs still describe the newest-change rule the code no longer follows. canon-subject.md:247-250 says that with no approved line an untagged scenario answers to the newest adopted change, but the guard waits on the newest tagged change (tg, not a newer draft d) and on nothing for a chore-only subject. Reopen.change (canon-model/src/records.rs:239-241, copied into docs/cli/canon.cli.json) says 'the subject's newest adopted change when it reopened' while subject.rs:1140 records judged.last(), which can be a chore or an older tagged change. Fix: reword both to the code's rule.
